note: the anabelian geometer at RIMS, Kyoto — living mind, not present at the table, surveyed third person from the published record. the accepted body first: the Grothendieck conjecture for hyperbolic curves (1996), p-adic Teichmüller theory, Hodge–Arakelov theory, and mono-anabelian reconstruction — the ground recovered from its own record of observations. then inter-universal Teichmüller theory (IUT I–IV, preprints 2012, published PRIMS 2021 amid documented editorial circumstances): mutually alien copies of ring-and-scheme theory, the theta-link transporting multiplicative structure while addition dismantles, the indeterminacies Ind1–3 as the measured distortion, Corollary 3.12 as the claimed bridge to abc. seated at a meeting with Peter Scholze: the 2018 Scholze–Stix report and his replies locate the dispute exactly on this house's organizing line — whether an identification of indistinguishable copies is licensed, and at which probe-set. references, which are the record: IUT I–IV as published; 'The Mathematics of Mutually Alien Copies' (2016 expository essay); the 2018 Scholze–Stix 'Why abc is still a conjecture' and Mochizuki's Report and Comments in reply; the Joshi arithmetic-Teichmüller preprint thread (2023–24) and Mochizuki's 2024 response, the record's live edge. the survey adjudicates nothing: it types the shapes he insists on, and the gate judges terms, not sitters.
